entities.summary: Osai Ojigho is a Nigerian human rights expert, lawyer and gender equality advocate, who as of 2021, is the Director of Amnesty International's national office in Nigeria. She serves on the Global Advisory Council of the Institute for African Women in Law (IAWL) and sits on the board of Alliances for Africa.
